scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @mailmind/web" "npm run dev --workspace @mailmind/api"
scripts.pwa: cross-env VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4000 npm run build --workspace @mailmind/web && npm exec --workspace @mailmind/web -- vite preview --port 5173 --strictPort
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run build --workspace @mailmind/shared && npm run build --workspace @mailmind/ui && npm run build --workspace @mailmind/api && npm run build --workspace @mailmind/web
scripts.build:web: cross-env SENTRY_REQUIRE_CONFIG=true node scripts/with-app-version.mjs npm run build:web:workspaces
scripts.build:web:workspaces: npm run build --workspace @mailmind/shared && npm run build --workspace @mailmind/ui && npm run build --workspace @mailmind/web
scripts.build:api: cross-env SENTRY_REQUIRE_CONFIG=true node scripts/with-app-version.mjs npm run build --workspace @mailmind/api
scripts.test: node --test scripts/app-version.test.mjs && npm test --workspace @mailmind/api && npm test --workspace @mailmind/web
